format-a-date-by-hand.why: Owner decision 146 ruling 1 -- every figure the system writes is in Western digits. `'ar-JO'` switches to Eastern Arabic-Indic numerals, so this one date would print ٠١٢٣ beside money that prints 0123, on one screen in one language. The gate's budget is ZERO, not a ratchet: every one of the seven sites was the same mistake.
